classifications.primary_reported: Manufacturer, constructor, period observation or named owner/builder/seller describing own work or specimen; may be retrospective, unmeasured or incomplete.
classifications.secondary_reported: Secondary editorial, tertiary or catalogue assertion; applicability and measurement provenance may be unresolved.
classifications.vendor_replica: Current reproduction product or replica-system statement, never automatically historical OEM.
classifications.forum_proposal: Unbuilt or unvalidated proposal, not a measured result.
classifications.inferred: Explicit arithmetic or engineering inference; not an independent source observation.
classifications.missing: Null: required quantity not established; never zero.

admission_policy: All automatic_model_admission and physical_validation_established flags are false. Reported facts can select topology or document context; any numerical simulation use requires human variant/condition/uncertainty review. Original lane adoption flags do not override this rule.

unit_policy.hp_unqualified: Preserve source label; never assume PS or mechanical hp.
unit_policy.pressure: Preserve gauge/absolute ambiguity; boost is not fan pressure rise.
unit_policy.temperature: Use delta degrees only when source does not specify scale; never turn recollected reductions into measured heat flux.
unit_policy.conversion_note: Extra numerical digits reflect arithmetic only, not source accuracy.
